ai.title: AI assistant
ai.description: Connect your personal model provider. Your API key is stored securely and is never shown again.
ai.key_saved: A key is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
ai.error: Unable to update or load settings. Reload to check the current state.
ai.chat_description: Ask about this workspace or request changes. Changes may take effect immediately. Chat history is temporary and clears when you close or navigate away.
ai.chat_error: The request did not complete. Some actions may already have taken effect. Check the workspace before sending again.
ai.empty_response: The assistant completed without a response.
ai.interrupted_guidance: This turn did not finish. Some changes may already have taken effect. Check the workspace, then clear this chat before sending another request. Clearing chat does not undo changes.
ai.model_tool_fragment: This is text returned by the model. Check the tool records for actual execution results.
ai.tool_no_details: No additional result details were returned.
ai.tool_truncated: This preview is shortened. Open the work item or request a smaller result for more detail.
ai.base_url_help: Use any HTTP(S) provider endpoint, including enterprise or local gateways. Leave blank for the provider default.
ai.model_search: Search models by name or ID
ai.models_error: Unable to fetch models. Check the connection details and try again.
ai.models_truncated: The provider returned a partial model list. Some models may be missing.
ai.vision_detected: The provider reports that this model supports image input.
ai.vision_unavailable: The provider reports that this model does not support image input.
ai.vision_unknown: The provider has not reported image support. Enable this only if your model accepts images.
ai.image_vision_required: Enable image input in AI settings to attach images.
ai.image_invalid: Use PNG, JPEG or WebP images up to 2 MB each.
ai.image_limit: Use up to 3 images in a conversation.
ai.image_paste_error: Unable to read the pasted image.
